These are mostly BARE ROCK, not inhabited islands or cities. Powerful green magnetic currents arc and bend between the rocks, visibly deflecting dust and tugging at the Argonaut’s flight wake. Exactly ONE bronze Zeppelin capital ship, the ARGONAUT, enters a tight gap between towering rocks, small enough to show the huge scale but its full silhouette still readable. Foreground massive rocks and tangled currents make navigation visibly difficult. Veymarch crimson banner with SILVER emblem on the Argonaut. No other vessels, no enemy fleet, no battle, no guns firing. Dramatic navigation and dangerous terrain, not a peaceful city panorama.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
